name: mdp
description: Turn content into a polished page, slide deck, flyer, report, one-pager, memo, or letter with MDP, then show or present it.

interface.shortDescription: Show content as a page, deck, flyer, report, one-pager, memo, or letter
interface.longDescription: MDP compiles one plain .mdp source into design-locked artifacts: a calm reading page, a full-screen slide deck, a promotional flyer, a paginated report with a cover and auto table of contents, a dense one-pager leave-behind, an internal memo, and a formal letter. The author writes meaning only and the engine owns all design, so the output cannot look junky. Use it to present, show, or hand off content.
defaultPrompt: Show this as a slide deck.
Make a one-page flyer from these notes.
Render this README as a clean page.
Turn this into a report with a table of contents.
Draft this as a memo to the team.
